description: PM-F2. The validator used to accept any pair of distinct unit ids as a leader attachment. The game then never offers the illegal pairing and the AI silently substitutes its own — the author sees the plan 'work' while the attachment they asked for never happens (found because the PM-0 rich fixture originally paired Wazdakka Gutsmek, who has no Leader ability, with Warbikers). The validator now mirrors FormationsPhase's checks as WARNINGS, and this proves the note actually reaches a player: a plan with an impossible attachment shows a warning badge in the AI Plans browser, in the warning colour not the invalid colour, and selecting the row names the character and the rule. The well-formed rich fixture sits beside it as the control row.
